mapper.select: SELECT id, org_name, parent_id, org_level, org_code, is_active, synced_at FROM dim_org WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY org_level, id

WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS ( SELECT id FROM dim_org WHERE id = #{orgId} AND is_active = TRUE UNION ALL SELECT c.id FROM dim_org c INNER JOIN subtree p ON c.parent_id = p.id WHERE c.is_active = TRUE ) SELECT id FROM subtree

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT id, org_name, parent_id, 1 AS depth FROM dim_org WHERE id = #{orgId} UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.org_name, p.parent_id, a.depth + 1 FROM dim_org p INNER JOIN ancestors a ON a.parent_id = p.id ) SELECT STRING_AGG(org_name, ' > ' ORDER BY depth DESC) FROM ancestors
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dim_org (id, org_name, parent_id, org_level, org_code, is_active, synced_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{orgName}, #{parentId}, #{orgLevel}, #{orgCode}, #{isActive}, #{syncedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE dim_org SET org_name = #{orgName}, parent_id = #{parentId}, org_level = #{orgLevel}, org_code = #{orgCode}, is_active = #{isActive}, synced_at = #{syncedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dim_org SET is_active = FALSE, synced_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
